ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white and 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous low-intensity black region extending from the peduncle base. High-intensity white regions dominate the lateral lobes, featuring low-intensity mottling and streaking concentrated near the trailing edges and lower lobe junctions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration across both lobes. A distinct, large macro-level notch is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe approximately 20% along the span from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing boundary, tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curving lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Collection of high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle scarring) localized in the lower central black region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions; prominent diagonal rake-like marks on the left lobe and vertical scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation/notch on the inner right lobe trailing edge; jagged erosion of the extreme right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Speckled high-contrast transition zone where the central black pigmentation meets the white lobe pigmentation.
